n_9d02aec595e26d30.name: Choose the next message
n_9d02aec595e26d30.source: export default function next({events,previousState}){if(!Array.isArray(events)||events.length>50)throw Error('Invalid Gmail page');for(const e of events)if(typeof e?.messageId!=='string'||!e.messageId)throw Error('Missing Gmail message ID');const index=previousState==null?0:previousState.index+1;if(!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>events.length)throw Error('Invalid message progress');return {state:{index},more:index<events.length,messageId:events[index]?.messageId??'',count:index}}

n_3a17f13e4f872eb4.name: Prepare classification
n_3a17f13e4f872eb4.source: export default function prepare({expectedId,messageId,messageText,organization,priorityLabel,workLabel,promotionLabel}){if(!expectedId||messageId!==expectedId||typeof messageText!=='string'||!messageText.trim())throw Error('Missing or mismatched message body');for(const x of [organization,priorityLabel,workLabel,promotionLabel])if(typeof x!=='string'||!x.trim()||x.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure organization and all Gmail label IDs');return{body:messageText,organization,priorityLabel,workLabel,promotionLabel}}

n_51281f197d71b2d5.name: Confirm the labeled message
n_51281f197d71b2d5.source: export default function confirm({expectedId,messageId}){if(typeof expectedId!=='string'||!expectedId||messageId!==expectedId)throw Error('Gmail label result does not match; inspect mailbox before retry');return {ok:true}}
